title: Chess Salon
description:
Enter the Chess Salon, where you can play against your favourite characters. Watch as they strategise, bluff, and outmanoeuvre your opponents in a battle of wits and skill.

Features:
- Play against your characters: Challenge your characters to a game of chess and see how they fare against you.
- Watch them strategize: Observe as your characters plan their moves, anticipate your tactics, and react to the changing board state.
- Engage in lively banter: Enjoy witty commentary and playful trash talk from your characters as you play.
